occasions.lede: Birthday, wedding, farewell party, or just because: the occasion doesn't matter. Here are a few examples among countless others.

moments.h2: A few moments, among so many stories

karting.title: Yanis's crew, before he left
karting.story: He was leaving in two months and wanted one last night with his friends before that. We booked a private go-kart track for a late-night session, followed by dinner well into the night.

voiture-luxe.title: Aymeric's son, a lifelong car fan
voiture-luxe.story: His 8-year-old had talked about nothing but Lamborghinis for months. For his birthday, we arranged a surprise Huracán parked outside his house, plus a drive around the block with his dad behind the wheel.

evjf-boite-nuit.title: Apolline's friends, the night before the wedding
evjf-boite-nuit.story: They wanted a real Parisian night out, not just drinks at a bar. We booked a VIP table at a club in the city centre, bottle service and skip-the-line access included. The bride-to-be didn't pay for a thing that night.

parc-des-princes.title: Enzo, lifelong PSG supporter
parc-des-princes.story: He'd always dreamed of watching a Champions League match at Parc des Princes with his best friend, but could never get tickets. We found two seats for a big European night.

star-dior.title: Capucine, for one evening
star-dior.story: She'd always wondered what it feels like to be followed around like a celebrity, just once. We staged a fake shopping outing outside a Paris boutique, complete with two bodyguards and a cameraman trailing her.

degustation-vin.title: Baptiste, for his father's day
degustation-vin.story: He wanted to thank his dad with something other than a tie. We arranged a private tasting in a Paris wine cellar, just the two of them with a sommelier, and a cheese board that lasted until the last bottle.

evg-boite-nuit.title: Anatole's crew, before the wedding
evg-boite-nuit.story: His friends wanted one last memorable night out before the wedding. We booked a VIP booth at a Paris club, bottles included, with a view over the dancefloor until the early hours.

saut-parachute.title: Gaspard's friends, for his 30th
saut-parachute.story: His friends wanted to mark the milestone with something other than a restaurant. We organised a group skydive at sunset, followed by dinner to relive it all while it was still fresh.

pique-nique.title: Léna, a spur-of-the-moment picnic
pique-nique.story: He wanted something simple but memorable for their couple's anniversary. We set up a picnic at the foot of the Eiffel Tower at sunset, champagne included, with snacks until nightfall.

gt3rs-circuit.title: Roman, thrill-seeker
gt3rs-circuit.story: He dreamed of taking the wheel of a GT3RS on track, coached by a pro driver. We arranged a full day on the circuit, Yurday-branded helmet included, to live it like a real driver.

roses-cartier.title: Margaux, a hundred roses for no particular reason
roses-cartier.story: He wanted to surprise her without waiting for a specific occasion. We had a hundred red roses delivered along with a Cartier box and a note tucked inside, all arranged in just a few days.

coaching-boxe.title: Sacha, an hour with a coach all to herself
coaching-boxe.story: She wanted a break from her usual workout routine. We booked a private boxing session with a coach, in a studio just for them, away from crowded group classes.

appel-mbappe.title: Grégoire's son, die-hard Les Bleus fan
appel-mbappe.story: His 10-year-old only ever talked about the French national team and his idol. For his birthday, we arranged a surprise video call with Kylian Mbappé, filmed without him suspecting a thing.

croisiere-seine.title: Bernard, for their 30th wedding anniversary
croisiere-seine.story: He wanted to mark thirty years together with something more than another classic dinner. We booked a private dinner cruise on the Seine, table set facing the illuminated Eiffel Tower.

process.lede: Four steps, from the first message to the day itself.

steps.title: Tell us about the person
steps.body: Their passions, what they dislike, meaningful memories: everything that helps us build a truly bespoke day.

steps.title: We build the day
steps.body: Hour by hour, we bring together the right providers, with clear price options, never a surprise.

steps.title: You approve
steps.body: We adjust live with you until it's exactly right, no more, no less.

steps.title: We take care of everything
steps.body: Bookings, coordination on the day: all you have to do is enjoy the moment with them.

paragraphs: We knew exactly who we wanted to spoil, heads full of ideas… but no idea how to turn any of it into an actual day.
But everywhere we went, it was pre-built packages, boxes to tick.
So we imagined it all ourselves: the itinerary, the venues, the surprises, down to gathering their loved ones so they could play their part in the day too.
Seeing their surprise and their emotion, we understood: we hadn't just created an activity, but a whole story to live.
You give us the person, the occasion and your budget.
story.transition: The two faces behind every day

bios.leo: Makes sure to understand exactly what you have in mind, before even talking about providers.
bios.luca: Builds the day and negotiates every detail so it all comes together, from budget to the big day.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Every day is different, so every budget is too. We always build the day around the starting budget you give us, never the other way around.

items.question: How far in advance should I contact you?
items.answer: As early as possible for maximum options, but we've put together projects in just a few days. Tell us your timeline and we'll tell you honestly what's possible.

items.question: Where do you operate?
items.answer: We currently operate in Paris and its surrounding area (Île-de-France). Tell us where you are and we'll quickly confirm if it's possible.

items.question: What if we're a group (bachelor/bachelorette party)?
items.answer: No problem: we always separate the person being celebrated from the group living the day, so the logistics (meals, transport, activities) are costed accurately, either per head or as a flat rate, whichever makes sense.

items.question: Is it really bespoke, or a disguised package?
items.answer: Truly bespoke. We don't work with fixed packages: if you want 8 activities in the day, we build 8 activities.

faq.closing: Got more questions? The easiest way is to tell us about your project, we'll answer with a response tailored just for you.

anniversaire.intro: Tell us about the birthday you have in mind for your loved one, and we'll imagine their perfect day, from the first surprise to the very last moment.
anniversaire.story: Yurday was actually born from a birthday: a wish to do things properly for someone we love, rather than settling for a gift unwrapped in ten seconds. Since then, we apply the same method to every birthday entrusted to us: we start from the person, never from a catalogue.

cta.title: Ready to write their story?
cta.text: Tell us who you want to spoil, and we'll get back to you with the first ideas within 48 hours.

demande-en-mariage.intro: Tell us how you picture your marriage proposal, and we'll take care of creating the setting, the timing and the surprise, without them suspecting a thing.
demande-en-mariage.story: A marriage proposal only happens once. That's why we take the time to build everything with you, from the first message to the big day: the location, the timing, the staging, and all the little details that will make this moment exactly the one you imagined.

cta.title: Ready to create this moment?
cta.text: Tell us your story and how you picture it, and we'll get back to you with the first ideas within 48 hours.

saint-valentin.intro: Tell us what you'd like to give the person who matters for Valentine's Day, and we'll design a bespoke day, far from the classic candlelit dinner.
saint-valentin.story: Valentine's Day often falls into the same rituals: a restaurant, flowers, a bit of last-minute rush. We'd rather start from who you love and what truly matters to them, to build a moment that's genuinely out of the ordinary, just for the two of you.

cta.title: Ready to go off the beaten path?
cta.text: Tell us who you'd like to surprise, and we'll get back to you with the first ideas within 48 hours.

evg-evjf.intro: Tell us about the bachelor or bachelorette party you have in mind, and we'll take care of organising an unforgettable day for the whole crew, logistics included.
evg-evjf.story: A great bachelor or bachelorette party means a group that enjoys itself from start to finish, with no one having to manage bookings or scheduling. We take care of all the coordination with the crew, so the only thing you have to do is have fun.

cta.title: Ready to organise THE day?
cta.text: Tell us who you want to celebrate and with whom, and we'll get back to you with the first ideas within 48 hours.

fete-des-meres.intro: Tell us what you'd like to give your mum for Mother's Day, and we'll imagine her perfect day, filled with everything she loves.
fete-des-meres.story: We know how hard it can be to find the right way to thank your mum, beyond flowers grabbed at the supermarket the night before. Tell us who she is and what she loves, and we'll build a day around her that truly feels like her.
